title: No way to contact!
text: I downloaded this app to help my son compress stop motion videos he is making, but once compressed the quality was lost. I don’t think this is related to the App, and the App worked really well; very easy to use. However, since it didn’t work for what we wanted, I want to cancel the subscription I had to sign up for. Free trial for 5 days then $35 a month, is what it states when I registered. Now I’m realizing that I got no email with the registration info, and there is no way to reach the developer or receive App support! Wishing I never used this product.
